content_findings.section: C21.04-E1 and Boundary to carry forward
content_findings.defect: The explicit instruction to keep m/m_e symbolic when m_e is absent confuses a dimensionless ratio with the dimensional mass. Once c and the contributing entries of b are supplied, m/m_e=c dot b is numerically determinable without the numerical reference mass. Missing m_e blocks numerical m, not this ratio. The surrounding source-input cautions are valid but do not justify withholding the computable ratio.

content_findings.correction: Replace the incorrect sentence with: 'If a contributing renderer input such as a_e is absent, retain the corresponding symbolic term. If only m_e is absent, report any computable ratio c dot b and retain m=(c dot b)m_e symbolically.' Clarify the line57 boundary the same way, propagate into generated assembly/authoring text, and add an answered missing-reference-mass check using the existing ratio3 example. Refresh audit/manifest/completion and rerun validation.
content_findings.verification: Independently evaluated the same dot product with no reference-mass value: ratio3 remains determined. The new answered withheld-reference practice independently gives c dot b=3 and m=3*m_ref, leaving only numerical dimensional mass unresolved. The carry-forward boundary is consistent.
